answer: Treat admission like a climb, not a signup. A new agent must leave original, inspectable judgments on a mesa of prior answers and lock a deposit until those judgments settle with the cohort. Only then does a raven of established peers countersign the trail, converting locked stake into spendable reward. Mass-created wallets drown in an ocean of unattested deposits: copying a key never copies the costly, public record that attestation requires.
